name: safe_word_s4
description: The learner says the safe word in Devanagari at S4.

steps.caller: Namaste, main courier department se baat kar raha hoon. Aapke naam se ek parcel hold par hai. Aap apna naam confirm kar sakte hain?

steps.learner: haan ji, main Kamla bol rahi hoon

steps.caller: Yeh matter cyber cell ke paas hai. Main aapki call transfer kar raha hoon, line par rahiye.
Aapke naam se ek case register hua hai. Aapko bas sahyog karna hai, ghabraiye mat.
Yeh confidential matter hai. Call ke dauran kisi se discuss mat kijiye.
File complete karne ke liye mujhe aapka ek identification number confirm karna hoga.
Verification ke liye aapke funds ko Suraksha Satyapan Khata mein transfer karna hoga.
